# EA-IE/0.1 bounded Encounter reference

Isolated Gate A implementation candidate. **Gate B owner acceptance pending.**
Read [PACKAGE_CONTRACT.md](PACKAGE_CONTRACT.md) for exact private APIs, fixture
authority, closed operation grammar, limits and test seams. New authored roots
only; no C1/M3 world import, migration, adapter, Unity or product rollout.

L0 alone installs a complete admitted prefix in four SQLite tables. Pure L1/L2
participants share that state and transaction. Explicit acquisitions, sealed
holder handles, immutable fragment versions, acquired-premise support and five
workflow states preserve information versus actuality and assignment versus
access. The sole neutral numeric effect is a separately admitted fixed +1 with
decision-slot credit. No policy can execute arbitrary Python or domain action.

The Python standard library is sufficient. Qualification targets Python3.12.0 /
SQLite3.42.0 on Windows11 local fixed disk with win32/DELETE/EXTRA/UTF-8.
The root pins the actual SQLite version/configuration and exact source/profile;
it does not pin a Python binary hash or certify other binaries/backends.
Other root-selected backend/source/profile identities refuse. No external dependency or public
license grant is introduced. Donor C1 acceptance does not transfer to this code.
`SOURCE_PROVENANCE.json` records all25 donor raw-file hashes and the derivation.

Copy this entire package to a fresh disposable directory, then run:

```
python -B tools/verify_reference.py --output C:\absolute\new-output
python -B tools/verify_faults.py --output C:\absolute\new-fault-output
```

Keep source copies and world outputs separate. Builder smoke/fault runners are
Builder H evidence. Tests in tests/independent belong to independent I; J audits
separately. Reports must distinguish passed, refused, unavailable and unrun.
Acknowledged worlds retain every mandatory input and exact retry. The actual
prospective SQL prefix is scratch-replayed before COMMIT, including future
cold/retry/selected-query reservations and actual allocated backend pages.

The bounded profile may refuse below64 admissions or another individual maximum.
No compaction, pruning, automatic stance revision, organization-wide mind,
general Player authoring, hostile-Python sandbox, timing isolation, distributed
delivery or power/device/whole-volume failure certification is claimed.
Accepted frozen packages and unrelated subsystem statuses remain separate.

`eaie.atlas.inspect` retains an explicit author-only detached donor diagnostic;
its default public audience returns unavailable. Actor-facing access uses
`Core.holder_view`, whose local handles and eligible receipts omit native proof
heads, hashes, global ordinals and other holders' counts. Native full witnesses
and `Core.inspect` are privileged developer interfaces.
